jamie: Quick a11y check on the new Insights mini-chart + table row behavior. Keyboard users report the focus halo vanishes when rows virtualize. Also legend colors aren't read with the series name. rachel: I can repro on mac/Chrome. Focus shows briefly then disappears when virtualization swaps nodes. dennis: Likely cause: row element is unmounted while focused. Short-term fix: move focus to a stable ancestor (.row-shell) or keep the row DOM stable while focused. leo: For the ring, box-shadow on :focus-visible works better than outline since stacking contexts clip outlines. Example CSS I used: `.row-shell:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(1,102,255,0.95); border-radius: 6px; }` Also add forced-colors fallback: `@media (forced-colors: active) { .row-shell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid CanvasText; box-shadow: none; } }` jamie: For charts, screen readers just say "image". We should give the svg an accessible name and make legend items explicit. Small HTML sketch: `` and legend `
  • ` rachel: Also there's a hidden anchor we added for tracking that ends up in the tab order. Change it to `tabindex="-1"` and `aria-hidden="true"` so it doesn't trap keyboard users. a11y-bot: Axe run 2027-06-12: flagged focusable hidden element, missing accessible name on chart, and low contrast on selected-row label in light theme. dennis: Action items: 1) I'll open INF-4999 with repro steps + NVDA/VoiceOver snippets, 2) leo -> PR to switch to row-shell focus ring and forced-colors fallback + add Playwright e2e that tabs through rows and ensures focus doesn't vanish, 3) rachel -> add aria-labelledby/desc and explicit legend labels; run screen reader checks. leo: Will include `prefers-reduced-motion` guard for any animated focus effects too. jamie: Thanks team 44d Please attach screenshots and browser versions in INF-4999.
